scope: Phase 3 initial selections and evidence/implementation-quality reassessment; records only

source: Everything should be based on evidence, no assumptions.
Decisions should be best for implementation code, not fastest/easiest/most convenient.
Reevaluate earlier suggestions if these requirements change them; persist the rules for compaction.

answers.answer: This feels like something we should do research on and establish best practices, community preferences, et cetera.

evidence: Existing Interaction, Places, StoreEffect and Store selectors have concrete consumers.
Lit documents controller composition and lifecycle hooks.
audit.gap: No equivalent-contract comparison proves every responsibility should be a controller.
audit.next: Compare two real consumers and lifecycle interactions with a focused helper or specialised base where appropriate.

audit.status: Accepted platform direction; combined behaviour unverified
evidence: Current dialogs/drawers use showModal; anchored surfaces use Popover.
Official platform documentation describes modal inertness and top-layer behaviour.
audit.gap: Local precedent and platform features do not certify nested focus, dismissal or all-engine behaviour.
audit.next: Probe nested modal/non-modal surfaces, shadow focus, Escape/outside handling, opener removal, scrolling, origin theme and resize in Chromium/Firefox/WebKit.

evidence: Existing exits use inconsistent timers/animation collection.
Sheet collects descendant animations, including potentially unrelated infinite animations.
audit.gap: The requirement is justified; no completed ownership implementation was tested.
audit.next: Verify interruption/reopen, reduced motion, infinite child animation, removal, nested locks and exactly-once focus/resource release.

evidence: Copy Button stale derived state previously reproduced in Chrome.
Six inline Bun/happy-dom checks pass for one Boolean accessor.
audit.gap: No comparative generalisation proof, compiler/CEM/React integration or all-engine verification.
audit.next: Compare explicit store-backed accessors and controlled update bridging with initialization, converters, defaults/reflection, inheritance, upgrade timing, equality/batching, compiler, CEM, React and browsers.

audit.status: Accepted responsibility; internal reuse shape open
evidence: Repeated form plumbing and inconsistent callbacks in current controls.
Previous browser checks found required validity and disabled-fieldset gaps.
audit.gap: One family is not enough to prove controller/mixin/base choice or a universal serializer.
audit.next: Compare real Lit implementations and test text, checkbox, radio group and compound controls; submit/reset/restore, form owner, validity focus and optional TanStack Form.

evidence: Current root storage and global data-dark mirroring do not satisfy nested-theme requirements.
Peter selected separation of preference saving and effective resolution.
audit.gap: No measured superiority or complete scope propagation model.
audit.next: Compare CSS inheritance with minimal runtime metadata against imperative propagation using nested/moved/custom scopes and opened overlays.

audit.status: UNSELECTED; research required before renewed recommendation
evidence: Producer/build ownership is scattered; build reverse-parses generated Lit modules.
External pipeline comparison is in progress.
audit.gap: The initial CSS-first recommendation preceded adequate comparison; no community preference established.
audit.next: Compare actual supported pipelines and versioned outputs in Material, Spectrum and Web Awesome, including different generations; preserve mandatory generator ownership.

evidence: Input duplicates Places tracking; slot and reconnect cases remain.
Interaction has temporary listener and focus-within cleanup gaps.
audit.gap: Observed defects do not approve one universal composition tracker.
audit.next: Verify real consumer cases; compare extending current small modules with alternatives before fixing their scope.

priorReviewScope.phase3: All six accepted directions reassessed against source/probe evidence.
priorReviewScope.earlierPass: Targeted check of composition/Item/Group, Lit Motion, Flow Diagram and related ownership records. Not a new full revalidation of every Phase 1/2 decision.
priorReviewScope.finding: No current evidence requires reversal of the selected directions. Stronger comparative/behaviour evidence is needed before finalizing implementation mechanisms; smaller/faster is not proof of better.
